name: The Water Castle That Drowned Itself
scope: The intact Gedhong Panggung on Pulo Kenanga at Taman Sari, Yogyakarta, with its three immediate terraces and exterior stair approaches, as illustrated in 1859.

stories.title: The Water Castle That Drowned Itself

originalReview.notes: The intact Gedhong Panggung has a high central pyramidal tile roof, parallel side links, tall end gables, pale plaster, dark recessed openings and a terraced approach.

review.method: Exact public-domain 1859 lithograph already published by Qualla
review.notes: The bytes Qualla publishes match the archive original. Buddingh’s 1859 plate is public domain. It depicts the intact roofline before the 1867 earthquake. Current photographs and other historical images were not needed.
